headline: Ankle-high and soft — nothing doing.
today: Weak SE swell, glassy at dawn but barely there, cross-on filling in through the day. Not worth an hour and a half. Sit this one out.

daysToWatch.note: Biggest of the week to 4.3ft SE — fair angle and short period, but afternoon WNW cross-off and light NE evening give you clean windows on real size. Shortboard or fish.
Small but prime E angle at 6.5s with light NW dawn — clean fun waist-high if you want a mellow session. Groveler.
